title: Regular non-normal modal classicalities
summary: We present a novel investigation into the consistency operator ($\circ$), traditionally associated with paraconsistent logics, as a means of capturing non-normal modal classicalities within the Kripke framework. By semantically reinterpreting $\circ$ as an operator that distinguishes top and bottom values from other values in the algebra, we extend its applicability beyond paraconsistency into classical and modal logics.
